sloka: दर्शनं चापि लङ्कायाः सीताया रावणस्य च ।तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे हनुमद्वदनोन्मुखाः ।। 5.57.49 ।।।।
transliteration: darśanaṁ cāpi laṅkāyāḥ sītāyā rāvaṇasya ca ।tasthuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve hanumadvadanonmukhāḥ ।। 5.57.49 ।।।।

translations.english: All the vanaras longing to listen to Hanuman about his crossing the ocean, seeing Lanka, Sita and Ravana kept looking at the face of Hanuman.
